summary: Import wave: 7 cards carrying Cavalry, Conqueror, or Tactician found while searching all 228 not-yet-imported cards with those keywords (plus Kensai). Daigotsu Kendo (pure Conqueror reminder text), Ikoma Natsu (Cavalry + an inert control-transfer restriction), Mirumoto Reiyu (Force penalty = her own current Force, reuses enemy-force), Shinjo Horibe and Doji Atsumichi (bow-or-straighten, same shape as paid-bow/paid-straighten, gated on opposed/lower-Honor-than-self), Tetsuo (destroy an attachment plus destroy an enemy with fewer Weapons than himself), Moto Shunsuke (new force-max-dead-pile Effect plus MakeDead with an owner restriction). Only 30 of 228 candidates had downloaded scans; 2 more (Nishimura, Utaku Elite Guard) were judged achievable but deferred as riskier, the other 21 are genuinely blocked on real gaps (documented per-card in docs/ROADMAP.md). Shared-file change: docs/ROADMAP.md is the cross-lane living checklist by design; all code changes are rules-lane engine-only, no client files touched.
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client: 85/85 core tests (6 new, covering all 7 cards), 33/33 published, 8/8 deck-format, plus AI/server/client-transport checks -- all pass.
remaining: 21 of the 30 scan-available candidates remain genuinely blocked on unbuilt mechanisms (documented per-card); 2 more (Nishimura, Utaku Elite Guard) are achievable but deferred pending further design confidence; the other ~200 candidates from the full 228-card search have no downloaded reference scan.
